avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 induction reduces rimegepant plasma concentrations and therapeutic efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; consider alternative herbal products if needed

avoid_supplements.name: Echinacea
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May induce CYP3A4, potentially decreasing rimegepant levels
avoid_supplements.action: Use with caution and monitor for reduced efficacy

caution_supplements.name: Grapefruit seed extract
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild CYP3A4 inhibition may modestly increase rimegepant exposure
caution_supplements.action: Inform patient of potential interaction; monitor for increased side effects

caution_supplements.name: Goldenseal
caution_supplements.mechanism: Contains berberine with potential CYP3A4 effects
caution_supplements.action: Use with caution; counsel patient on monitoring

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit and grapefruit juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 and P-glycoprotein inhibition significantly increases rimegepant bioavailability and adverse effects
avoid_foods.action: Strictly avoid grapefruit products during rimegepant therapy

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May increase rimegepant absorption rate and peak plasma concentrations
caution_foods.action: Take consistently with or without food; counsel on consistent dosing pattern

monitoring_notes: Rimegepant is metabolized primarily via CYP3A4 and transported by P-glycoprotein; clinicians should screen for potent CYP3A4 inhibitors/inducers and counsel patients to maintain consistent dietary patterns. Monitor for therapeutic failure or increased adverse effects if dietary or supplement changes occur.
